verses.text: Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
lines: Praise Yah!
Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh,
who delights greatly in his commandments.

verses.text: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
lines: His offspring will be mighty in the land.
The generation of the upright will be blessed.

verses.text: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
lines: Wealth and riches are in his house.
His righteousness endures forever.

verses.text: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
lines: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright,
gracious, merciful, and righteous.

verses.text: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
lines: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends.
He will maintain his cause in judgment.

verses.text: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
lines: For he will never be shaken.
The righteous will be remembered forever.

verses.text: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
lines: He will not be afraid of evil news.
His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.

verses.text: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
lines: His heart is established.
He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

verses.text: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
lines: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor.
His righteousness endures forever.
His horn will be exalted with honor.

verses.text: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
lines: The wicked will see it, and be grieved.
He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away.
The desire of the wicked will perish.
